overview.Name: Excelerate Energy, Inc.
overview.Description: Excelerate Energy, Inc. owns and operates liquefied natural gas (LNG) and natural gas infrastructure assets. The company operates floating regasification terminals. It also offers various terminal services, including providing the crew, and technical and other services related to the floating regasification terminal's operation. In addition, the company sells natural gas, LNG, power, and steam. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. Excelerate Energy, Inc. is a subsidiary of Excelerate Energy Holdings, LLC.
